decisions.label: Aceptar como contrato real suficiente
decisions.allowed_only_if: There is explicit evidence that the field exists in a non-fixture real flow/signal.
decisions.impact_on_ROB004: Could clear only for idempotencyKey/correlationId if accepted with real-flow evidence.
decisions.impact_on_ROB005: Could clear only for officialFlowRef if accepted with real-flow evidence.
decisions.impact_on_ROB008: Does not clear automatically; synthetic fixture values still need real replacements.
decisions.next_allowed_step: OBSERVER_DESIGN_REVIEW_V1 only if all real-signal and no-cableado conditions are also satisfied.
decisions.forbidden_step: Do not proceed if acceptance is based only on shadow, fixture, test or audit evidence.

decisions.next_allowed_step: REPLAY_ONLY_CONTINUES_V1 or further replay/offline adapter strengthening.
